channel.title: Searchscope Blog
channel.description: Writing on search systems, algorithm updates, AI search and search data.

item.title: Page Experience
item.description: What's broken on your pages, what it still earns, and how to fix it. Technical health, index coverage and speed in one instrument, with Google's own answer next to ours.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: Names you weren't getting credit for
item.description: AI engines don't always use your full company name. Searchscope spots the variants your saved brand names miss and offers them for approval, with the evidence attached.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: All six AI engines, live
item.description: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Claude and Gemini are all part of every visibility run. Where they disagree is usually more useful than the combined score.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: The Content Planner
item.description: One plan for everything you're creating, across SEO and PR, built from the data Searchscope already holds about you. Each piece hands off to Content Studio to build.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: Send any strategist reply to Content Studio
item.description: Every Strategic Advisor reply now carries a Send to Studio action, and the whole conversation travels with it rather than the single message you clicked from.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: A rebuilt AI visibility overview
item.description: Your score, how often you're named and cited, your share of voice, and where you land inside the answer. Every number shows what it's out of.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: Worksheets
item.description: Any workspace can become a live sheet your team works through, with status, priority and notes. Generate recommendations for many rows at once, with a preview first.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: Prompt suggestions from your own search data
item.description: Searchscope turns the searches that already bring people to your site into the questions buyers ask AI, then checks how often those questions get asked.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: A demo on every page
item.description: Seventeen narrated walkthroughs, one for each surface, played from a Watch demo button on the page you're actually looking at.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: SEO is now an operating system
item.description: For two decades SEO came in projects: audit, fix, wait a quarter. That model breaks the moment search starts changing faster than you can audit it.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: What AI Overviews change about visibility
item.description: You can rank first and lose the click. You can be absent from the ten blue links and still be the source an AI quotes. Position was always a proxy; now it's a leaky one.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: Cannibalization is a data problem
item.description: Most cannibalization advice comes down to which pages feel similar. The real thing has a fingerprint in your search data: one query, several URLs, impressions split and click-through down on all of them.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: Reading demand vs. your share
item.description: One view beats rankings and traffic lines: market demand plotted against the share you capture. The quadrant with high demand and low share is where the growth is hiding.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)

item.title: The co-pilot model for search teams
item.description: AI won't replace your search team, and a team working without it will be outpaced. Aviation settled this decades ago, and the model transfers better than most analogies do.
item.author: noreply@searchscope.io (Ray)
